capabilities.rationale: The source exposes public member-entry shells, but authenticated evidence and credentials are unavailable. Login and registration fail closed and create no account or session.
The captured forgot-password shell is reproduced, but submissions truthfully return member access unavailable and create no reset challenge.

An approved local-sandbox enrollment atomically enqueues one branded policy-confirmation business-mail job. Offline runs retain it as LOCAL_SIMULATION; REAL_EMAIL_AUTHORIZED=false and no provider delivery is invoked.
A non-payment enrollment is the local order analogue: it binds one deterministic policy number to a quote and is idempotent by quote id.
The frozen quote funnel includes contact checkout. The local contract records synthetic contact, billing frequency, paperless choice, and terms acceptance only.

The candidate adds an explicitly clone-local payment continuation using only opaque local-sandbox scenario IDs. Amount, owner, currency and fingerprint are server-derived; card, bank, token, Stripe-test and live payment inputs remain forbidden.
Quotes, pets, rating selections, and non-payment enrollments require a site-bound SQLite database with migrations, reset, restart, backup, and concurrency proofs.
